# A strict run refuses a config that leaves data_subjects, detection or
# traceability undeclared while loading it, before it reads the report: the
# error comes even when the report does not exist, after the warnings any run
# prints at load.
! exec vens generate --strict --llm=mock --config-file=undeclared.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222 missing-report.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'level=WARN msg="context.traceability is not declared: Loss of accountability uses its `none` column, 7 or 9 on every finding."'
stderr 'level=WARN msg="context.detection is not declared: every channel counts as not logged, so Intrusion detection is 9 on every finding."'
stderr 'level=WARN msg="context.data_subjects is not declared: '
stderr 'strict: context.data_subjects, context.detection, context.traceability not declared, so each would fall back to its worst case'
! stderr 'missing-report'
! exists out.cdx.json

# The refusal also comes before the provider is set up: with no API key, a
# strict run still names the undeclared fields, where a run that is not
# strict stops at the missing key.
env OPENAI_API_KEY=
! exec vens generate --strict --llm=openai --config-file=undeclared.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222 missing-report.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'strict: context.data_subjects, context.detection, context.traceability not declared'
! stderr 'OPENAI_API_KEY'
! exec vens generate --llm=openai --config-file=undeclared.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222 missing-report.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'openai: OPENAI_API_KEY is not set'
! stderr 'strict:'

# Before any LLM call, a strict run refuses every CVE with no usable CVSS v3
# vector, whatever the cause, a v4 vector alone included, and every CVE no
# row describes. One error names each; CVE-2024-0007, complete, is not named.
! exec vens generate --strict --llm=mock --attest --config-file=declared.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222 report.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'strict: 6 vulnerabilities would fall back to a worst case, so no LLM call is made:'
stderr 'CVE-2024-0001: cvss_v3_missing: no CVSS v3 vector in the scanner''s report, so Loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability take their worst level'
stderr 'CVE-2024-0002: cvss_v3_missing: no usable CVSS v3 vector, so Loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability take their worst level: nvd CVSS 3.1 vector \\"CVSS:3.1/AV:N/garbage\\": \\"garbage\\" is not a metric:value pair'
stderr 'CVE-2024-0003: cvss_v3_missing: .*nvd CVSS 3.1 vector \\"CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N\\": A is absent or off H, L and N'
stderr 'CVE-2024-0004: cvss_v3_missing: .*redhat CVSS 3.1 vector \\"CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:X/A:N\\": I is absent or off H, L and N'
stderr 'CVE-2024-0005: cvss_v3_missing: no CVSS v3 vector in the scanner''s report'
stderr 'CVE-2024-0006: no description in the scanner''s report, so Motive, Opportunity and Ease of exploit are not asked and take their worst case'
! stderr 'CVE-2024-0007:'
stderr 'Scoring run finished.* llm_calls=0 .*failed=true'
! exists out.cdx.json
! exists out.attestation.cdx.json
! exec sh -c 'ls $VENS_TEMP_GLOB'

# Without --strict the same report is rated, each fallback counted.
exec vens generate --llm=mock --attest --config-file=declared.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222 report.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'Scoring run finished.* counters.cvss_v3_missing=5 .*failed=false'
exists out.cdx.json
exists out.attestation.cdx.json

# A strict run refused before any call leaves the VEX and the attestation a
# previous run wrote byte for byte.
cp out.cdx.json prev.cdx.json
cp out.attestation.cdx.json prev.attestation.cdx.json
! exec vens generate --strict --llm=mock --attest --config-file=declared.yaml --sbom-serial-number=urn:uuid:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222 report.json out.cdx.json
stderr 'strict: 6 vulnerabilities would fall back to a worst case, so no LLM call is made:'
cmp out.cdx.json prev.cdx.json
cmp out.attestation.cdx.json prev.attestation.cdx.json
! exec sh -c 'ls $VENS_TEMP_GLOB'

-- undeclared.yaml --
schema_version: 2
project:
  name: "strict-preflight"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
-- declared.yaml --
schema_version: 2
project:
  name: "strict-preflight"
context:
  exposure: "internet"
  data_sensitivity: "high"
  business_criticality: "critical"
  listener: present
  data_subjects: millions
  detection:
    network: logged
    host: not_logged
    application: logged_and_reviewed
  traceability: per_request
